structure.unit: Boundary Adjustments and Changes of Status of Counties, Cities and Towns
Consolidation of Like Units of Local Government

law.text: The election authorized by § 15.2-3505 shall be conducted in accordance with general law. The ballots used shall be printed and shall contain the following: "Shall ____________________ (here insert names of counties, cities or towns proposing to consolidate) consolidate pursuant to the consolidation agreement? [ ] Yes [ ] No."
